title: BuiltIn Keywords & Custom Keywords
description: Master Robot Framework's essential BuiltIn library keywords and create your first custom keywords to build reusable, maintainable test automation.
learningObjectives: Use core BuiltIn library keywords: Log, Sleep, and Set Variable
Import and use standard libraries (String, Collections)
Perform text manipulation with String library keywords
Work with lists using Collections library keywords
Create custom keywords in the Keywords section
Build reusable keyword abstractions for maintainable tests
Understand keyword naming conventions and best practices

keyTakeaways: BuiltIn library is automatically imported—no import statement needed
Log keyword outputs messages for debugging and verification
Set Variable assigns values to variables at runtime
Standard libraries (String, Collections) must be imported in Settings section
String library provides text manipulation: case conversion, replace, split, etc.
Collections library handles lists and dictionaries with advanced operations
Custom keywords are defined in *** Keywords *** section
[Arguments] setting must be first line in keyword body
Arguments make keywords flexible and reusable across different scenarios
Keyword abstraction layers improve test readability and maintainability
Use descriptive, action-oriented names for custom keywords
commonPitfalls: Using @{list} syntax with Create List (should be ${list})
Using tabs instead of spaces in Settings section imports
Not providing enough arguments when calling parameterized keywords
Creating overly generic keyword names (DoStuff, Helper, Test1)
Mixing abstraction levels in test cases
Duplicating logic instead of creating reusable keywords

realWorldApplications.description: Create custom keywords like 'Login As User' and 'Verify Dashboard' to abstract Selenium operations and improve test readability
Use String library to validate response formats and Collections to iterate over test data sets
Leverage Collections library with lists to run same test logic across multiple input datasets
Build custom initialization/cleanup keywords for consistent test environment management
Create parameterized keywords that accept browser/device arguments for multi-platform test execution
